Maintain and enable the demo certification process across ramping and ramped reps. Use data and feedback to measure the effectiveness of training programs and documentation. Continuously iterate and improve the user learning experience. Work closely with product managers and PMMs to understand new features and roadmap plans, and with marketing and sales to support go-to-market strategies. Define and track success metrics (time-to-product proficiency, adoption rates, feature utilization, customer expansion, NPS impact) and present data-driven insights to leadership. Stay current on product changes, competitive landscape, and industry trends; proactively identify opportunities to improve enablement quality. Experiment with product knowledge testing through innovative AI approaches. Move quickly and decisively in a high-velocity environment; adapt programs and priorities as business needs evolve without losing momentum. Attract top-tier talent to join our driven team.
